verdict.rationale: Inngest documents a REST API covering events, function runs, environments "and more". It also ships a CLI and an MCP server for inspecting runs, fetching traces, invoking functions and operating Inngest programmatically. Nothing in the pack shows full UI parity, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage of dashboard features such as AI Overview, webhook creation and evals management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Inngest REST API lets you interact with events, function runs, environments, and more programmatically.
Inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents access to your Inngest data from the terminal.
Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client to inspect and operate Inngest from your coding agent.
